newsitem.title: USA: Rubin to hold IRS news conference 1330EDT/1730GMT.
newsitem.headline: Rubin to hold IRS news conference 1330EDT/1730GMT.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin and Deputy Secretary Lawrence Summers will hold a news conference at 1:30 p.m. EDT (1730 GMT) to discuss a congressional panel's recommendations for reforming the tax-collecting IRS, the department announced.
The National Commission on Restructuring the Internal Revenue Service urged creating an outside board of directors to oversee the IRS, a proposal that Treasury opposes.

Rubin has not yet commented publicly on a brief market dive earlier this week caused by Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's remarks that the United States should cooperate on foreign exchange policy so that Japan would not be tempted to sell its holdings of U.S. Treasury securities.
